items.title: 8.4.1 Types of Intellectual Property (as printed; patents, trademarks, copyrights, industrial designs, trade secrets)

source_refs.note: Topic printed 8.4.1 Types of Intellectual Property (PDF 202-203, printed 199-200); numbering slips back to 8.4. The soft-drink recipe example is the book's claim. MCQ 9 is answered (d); key (b). Short questions 7-8 and long question 5 answered. Recorded.

blocks.caption: Types of intellectual property
rows: an invention: a new product or process; others may not make, use or sell it without permission
a Pakistani engineer's more efficient solar panel
a sign, logo or name that identifies a company's goods or services

literary and artistic works: books, music, films, paintings, software
